text: Appeal of Order to Comply (May 7, 2019) for 201 Cedric Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated May 7, 2019, regarding the property located at 201 Cedric Avenue, Folder No. 19 150145 PRS 00 IV. 2. Item 1 as listed in Schedule "A", in the Order to Comply, May 7, 2019, granted an extension of time to September 20, 2019. 3. Items 2 and 3 as listed in Schedule "A", in the Order to Comply, May 7, 2019, granted an extension of time to August 22, 2019.
